SierpinskiCarpet class compile: 'cellsAtLevel: anInteger
	"Generate the cells programmatically: a cell belongs to the carpet
	unless some ternary digit position has both coordinates equal to 1."
	| size cells |
	size := 3 raisedTo: anInteger.
	cells := Set new.
	0 to: size - 1 do: [ :x |
		0 to: size - 1 do: [ :y |
			(self ternaryConflict: x and: y atLevel: anInteger)
				ifFalse: [ cells add: x @ y ] ] ].
	^ cells' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
SierpinskiCarpet class compile: 'level: anInteger
	"A SierpinskiCarpet of the given recursion level: a 3^n x 3^n grid
	where every sub-block has its middle third removed. The carpet has
	8^n live cells."
	^ self new initializeCells: (self cellsAtLevel: anInteger)' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
SierpinskiCarpet class compile: 'new
    ^ super new initialize' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
SierpinskiCarpet class compile: 'ternaryConflict: x and: y atLevel: n
	| px py p |
	p := 1.
	n timesRepeat: [
		px := (x // p) \\ 3.
		py := (y // p) \\ 3.
		(px = 1 and: [ py = 1 ]) ifTrue: [ ^ true ].
		p := p * 3 ].
	^ false' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.

SierpinskiCarpet compile: 'cells

SierpinskiCarpet compile: 'openCarpetView
	"Render the carpet to a Form sized to fill the Pharo world and open
	it in a plain window. No zooming or fitting - the pixels are exact."
	| side usable pitch form window |
	side := (cells collect: #x) max + 1.
	usable := (World extent x - 12) @ (World extent y - 72).
	pitch := ((usable x min: usable y) // side) max: 1.
	form := Form extent: side * pitch @ (side * pitch) depth: 32.
	form fillColor: Color white.
	cells do: [ :p |
		form
			fill: ((p x * pitch) @ (p y * pitch) extent: pitch @ pitch)
			fillColor: Color black ].
	window := SystemWindow new.
	window setLabel: ''Sierpinski carpet''.
	window addMorph: (ImageMorph new form: form) frame: (0 @ 0 corner: 1 @ 1).
	window extent: (side * pitch) @ (side * pitch) + (12 @ 48).
	window openInWorld.
	window position: ((World extent x - window extent x) // 2) @ 18.
	^ window' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
SierpinskiCarpet compile: 'render
    | form canvas |
    form := Form extent: size asPoint depth: 32.
    canvas := FormCanvas on: form.
    self renderAtLevel: 0 at: 0 @ 0 on: canvas.
    ^ form' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
SierpinskiCarpet compile: 'renderAtLevel: currentLevel at: origin on: canvas
    | subSize rect |
    currentLevel = level
        ifTrue: [ 
            rect := origin extent: size asPoint / (3 raisedTo: level - currentLevel).
            canvas fillRectangle: rect color: Color black ]
        ifFalse: [ 
            subSize := size / (3 raisedTo: level - currentLevel).
            0 to: 2 do: [ :i |
                0 to: 2 do: [ :j |
                    (i = 1 and: [ j = 1 ]) 
                        ifFalse: [ 
                            self 
                                renderAtLevel: currentLevel + 1 
                                at: origin + (i * subSize @ (j * subSize)) 
                                on: canvas ] ] ] ]' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
DragonCurve class compile: 'dragonPointsAtOrder: anInteger
	"Deterministic doubling: keep the curve, then append the whole
curve
	minus its last point, reversed and rotated 90 degrees around the
	curve endpoint."
	| last |
	last := 0 @ 0.
	^ (2 to: anInteger) inject: (OrderedCollection with: 0 @ 0 with: 1 @ 0)
		into: [ :points :m |
			| end |
			end := points last.
			points allButLast reversed do: [ :p |
				points add: (end x + (p y - end y)) @ (end y - (p x - end x)) ].
			points ]' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
DragonCurve class compile: 'order: anInteger
	"A Heighway dragon curve. Order 1 is a single segment; every order
	doubles the segment count, so order n has 2^(n-1) segments and
	2^(n-1)+1 points."
	^ self new initializePoints: (self dragonPointsAtOrder: anInteger)' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
DragonCurve compile: 'initializePoints: aCollection
	points := aCollection' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
DragonCurve compile: 'openDragonView
	"Render the curve to a Form scaled to fill the Pharo world and open
	it in a plain window."
	| margin usable box scale offset form canvas window |
	points ifEmpty: [ ^ nil ].
	margin := 20.
	usable := (World extent x - (2 * margin)) @ (World extent y - 72 - (2 * margin)).
	box := Rectangle encompassing: points.
	scale := ((usable x / box width) min: (usable y / box height)) max: 1.
	offset := box origin negated * scale.
	form := Form extent: (usable x + (2 * margin)) @ (usable y + (2 * margin)) depth: 32.
	form fillColor: Color white.
	canvas := FormCanvas on: form.
	1 to: points size - 1 do: [ :i | | a b |
		a := (((points at: i) * scale) + offset) rounded + margin.
		b := (((points at: i + 1) * scale) + offset) rounded + margin.
		canvas line: a to: b width: 3 color: Color black ].
	window := SystemWindow new.
	window setLabel: ''Heighway dragon''.
	window addMorph: (ImageMorph new form: form) frame: (0 @ 0 corner: 1 @ 1).
	window extent: form extent + (12 @ 48).
	window openInWorld.
	window position: ((World extent x - window extent x) // 2) @ 18.
	^ window' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
DragonCurve compile: 'points

TwinDragon class compile: 'order: anInteger
	"Two Heighway dragons joined tail to tail: the second is the first
	rotated 180 degrees around the shared starting point. The pair is
	the classic Davis-Knuth twindragon."
	| first |
	first := (DragonCurve dragonPointsAtOrder: anInteger) asArray.
	^ self new
		initializeFirst: first
		second: (first collect: [ :p | p x negated @ p y negated ] as: Array)' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.

	^ curveOne' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.

		a := (((aCurve at: i) * scale) + offset) rounded + margin.
		b := (((aCurve at: i + 1) * scale) + offset) rounded + margin.
		canvas line: a to: b width: 3 color: aColor ]' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.

TwinDragon compile: 'openTwinDragonView
	"Render both dragon curves to a Form at a comfortable size, centered.
	The first dragon in black, its twin in red."
	| margin usable box scale offset form canvas window all |
	all := curveOne, curveTwo.
	margin := 20.
	usable := ((World extent x - (2 * margin)) @ (World extent y - 72 - (2 * margin))) * 0.75.
	usable := usable x asInteger @ usable y asInteger.
	box := Rectangle encompassing: all.
	scale := ((usable x / box width) min: (usable y / box height)) max: 1.
	offset := box origin negated * scale.
	form := Form extent: (usable x + (2 * margin)) @ (usable y + (2 * margin)) depth: 32.
	form fillColor: Color white.
	canvas := FormCanvas on: form.
	self drawCurve: curveOne on: canvas scale: scale offset: offset margin: margin color: Color black.
	self drawCurve: curveTwo on: canvas scale: scale offset: offset margin: margin color: Color red.
	window := SystemWindow new.
	window setLabel: ''Twin dragon''.
	window addMorph: (ImageMorph new form: form) frame: (0 @ 0 corner: 1 @ 1).
	window extent: form extent + (12 @ 48).
	window openInWorld.
	window position: ((World extent x - window extent x) // 2) @ ((World extent y - window extent y) // 2).
	^ window' classified: 'as yet unclassified'.
